name: Gustave Grisy
role: Mingusville cattleman; former partner of Pierre Wibaux
bio: Gustave Grisy was a cattleman and partner of Pierre Wibaux in Grisy & Wibaux, who in April 1884 praised the country and said his losses would fall under one percent; the partnership ended November 1, 1884, leaving Wibaux sole owner of the Royal Chambord ranch on Beaver Creek. Based at Mingusville, Montana, Grisy stayed active in stockmen's meetings into 1886, and that spring his sorrel horse won a race.
